subject.title: Crestodian talk-to-agent command can miss the app handoff

question: Should exact documented Crestodian host-navigation selectors such as `talk to agent` bypass the usable-model conversation path and return the app handoff deterministically?
rationale: Current source intentionally makes usable-model Crestodian turns AI-owned, but the documented macOS onboarding completion command is also a host-navigation action whose failure can strand a first-run user.

options.title: Make exact handoff host-side
options.body: Treat exact documented agent-handoff selectors like host navigation before the model path, and keep broader natural-language requests AI-owned.

options.title: Keep handoff model-owned
options.body: Accept that the app handoff depends on the model emitting the tool directive and document or surface an in-app recovery path.

options.title: Broaden the navigation audit
options.body: Pause this narrow fix and review every Crestodian host-navigation selector before changing the boundary.

recommendation.title: Make exact handoff host-side
recommendation.body: Treat exact documented agent-handoff selectors like host navigation before the model path, and keep broader natural-language requests AI-owned.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the live issue and linked fix PR and authored the central Crestodian onboarding/AI-loop history.
